approved.field: Paragraph: The Root Cause: Water Contamination
approved.oldValue: The outbreak was caused by contaminated water. The village's shallow wells and hand-pumps, which had served Bandwar for generations, were the source of the infection. The [[jal-jeevan-tank|Jal Jeevan Mission water tower]] had not yet reached all parts of the village at the time of the outbreak, and the affected wards were among the last to be connected. The outbreak became a powerful argument for accelerating the pipeline network's expansion, and it put the issue of clean water at the centre of the village's political and social agenda.
